title: Free-time clubs
body:
## Riverside Community Center — Free-time clubs

Do you want to meet new people? Do you like sports, music or art? Come to our clubs! All clubs are free for members.

**Soccer Club** — Tuesdays and Thursdays, 6:00–7:30 p.m. In the city park. For adults only. Bring sports shoes and water!

**Painting Club** — Wednesdays, 4:00–5:30 p.m. Room 3. Do you like painting, but you don't have paints? No problem: we have everything for you.

**Dance Club** — Fridays, 7:00–9:00 p.m. Main hall. Salsa, hip-hop and more. You don't need a partner.

**Kids' Swimming** — Saturdays, 10:00–11:00 a.m. At the pool. For children from 6 to 12. Parents stay with their children.

**Book Club** — Sundays, 11:00 a.m. The café. We read one book a month and talk about it over coffee.

The center doesn't open on Mondays. Questions? Write to clubs@riverside.example.com.
